name: Layer Ward
description: Draw veil upon veil of qi over the body until each layer lessens the force left for the next.

name: Echoing Return
description: Let a blow echo through the veils and return it to the striker with the full weight of every layer.

name: Purging Tide
description: Send a rising tide of clean qi through an ally and wash out poison and taint and a lingering curse.

name: Warding Chain
description: Wind the ward in chains of qi round an opponent and hold the opponent at the edge of the veils.

name: Titan Aegis
description: Raise an aegis of titanic weight that stands against a sustained assault by many strong foes.

name: Crushing Rebuke
description: Return a heavy blow with such force that the aegis crushes the striker's guard where it falls.

name: Quelling Pulse
description: Send a heavy pulse through the aegis that quells the qi of every foe within the field.

name: Mantle of Ages
description: Wrap the whole company in an old and patient mantle that grows stronger with every blow it endures.

name: Adamant Hush
description: Fold a hush of adamant stillness round one person and cancel a mighty strike at its first touch.

name: Peerless Return
description: Catch a mighty strike in the aegis whole and hurl it back at the one who loosed it.

name: Recalled Breathing
description: Close the aegis over an ally whose breath and pulse have just stopped and call both back within the first minutes.

name: Sovereign Aegis
description: The school's crowning move: an aegis in the user's sovereign hand that gives way to no single foe.

name: Calamity Aegis
description: Cancel a ruinous strike up to the destructive ceiling of its tier in one sweep of the aegis.

name: Doom Reversal
description: Turn a ruinous strike of the tier's ceiling upon its source with every layer of the aegis behind it.

name: Ceaseless Veil
description: Draw a veil from the Core's own store and keep it whole through the length of an assault.

name: Inward Fold
description: Fold the veil inward round a heavy blow and bury its force deep in the Core's reserve.

name: Spiral Rebuke
description: Spin the veil into a spiral that carries a blow round and back along the line it came by.

name: Core Tending
description: Send mending qi from the Core into a wounded ally and close deep wounds beneath the veil.

name: Pillar Aegis
description: Raise an aegis in a standing pillar of qi that bears the weight of a charge from above.

name: Unending Hush
description: Spread a hush that swallows each blow in turn for as long as the Core can feed it.

name: Stilling Weight
description: Lay the full weight of the ward on a foe and press the foe's qi down to a crawl.

name: Vast Mantle
description: Spread a vast mantle over the whole company and hold each member's guard firm.

name: Everstanding Plate
description: Set a plate so dense with Core qi that it stands against a mighty assault without wearing.

name: Absolute Return
description: Return a mighty strike with all the Core's weight added and no loss to the aegis.

name: Sundering Hush
description: Cancel a mighty blow and break the rhythm of the one who loosed it so the next never forms.

name: Starlit Aegis
description: The school's crowning move: a bright aegis from the Core that pales the blows it meets.

name: Radiant Mantle
description: The school's crowning move for the company: a radiant mantle drawn from the Core that firms every guard beneath it.

name: Worldward Veil
description: Spread a veil of the Core over the ground and cancel a ruinous strike up to the ceiling of its tier.

name: Final Refusal
description: Refuse a ruinous strike of the tier's ceiling and throw it back whole at its source.

name: Veil Divine
description: Draw a veil of divine energy over the user and the ally nearest at hand.

name: Gracious Mend
description: Mend an ally's wounds with divine energy so that flesh and bone return whole.

name: Pure Cleansing
description: Pour pure divine energy through an ally to lift out poison and taint and a deep curse.

name: Shroud Stride
description: Cross to a threatened ally in a single step with the veil carried over the distance.

name: Heaven Aegis
description: Raise an aegis of divine weight that stands against a host of strong foes.

name: Gentle Return
description: Return a blow so smoothly through the aegis that the striker feels only a quiet push.

name: Quiet Sovereign
description: Lay a quiet sovereign hand on a foe and press the foe's divine energy down to stillness.

name: Eternal Mantle
description: Cast a mantle that lasts as long as the user stands and firms every guard beneath it.

name: Immortal Hush
description: Hush a mighty strike to nothing in a still and deathless calm round the warded.

name: Divine Refusal
description: Refuse a mighty strike in the name of the aegis and send it back where it began.

name: Restoring Light
description: Pour divine light into an ally whose breath has just stopped and call the breath and pulse back at once.

name: Heavenward Aegis
description: The school's crowning move: the aegis rises heavenward over the warded and gives way to nothing of lesser grade.

name: Final Aegis
description: Answer a ruinous strike up to the destructive ceiling of the divine tier with an aegis that cancels it.
